title: Capacity Orchestra: quarterly playbook for reserved pools, surge choreography, and autoscale runbooks
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: produce an operational playbook and roadmap slice that coordinates reserved-pool scheduling, prewarm strategies, surge choreography across tiers, and autoscale fallback contracts for Q2 pilot. Scope: - Define SLA-aligned warm pool schedules that balance cost and latency for medium and high-priority customers. - Design surge choreography (multi-pool handoff + cross-region warm transfer) for 3 failure/fleet-congestion scenarios. - Specify canary phasing and rollback criteria for reservation hedging and fractional reservations. - Deliver measurable success criteria (SLOs, cost/unit delta, canary pass rate) and a handoff checklist for Eng/Platform/Support. Out of scope: billing model changes and negotiated enterprise contract terms; those will be separate spikes.
updates: 2026-01-13: Kickoff sync with Eng (runtime, infra), Reliability, and Solutions. Agreed to prototype surge choreography in simulation lab before prod canaries.

2026-01-18: Capacity lab sim v1 ran 72hr trace replay; prewarm heuristics reduced cold-start tail by 38% on p50 workload, but p99 increased under synthetic spike—engineering to investigate KV-cache warm ordering.
2026-01-20: PM/Finance sync: defined cost guardrails for fractional reservations (delta <= 12% QoQ). Finance requested an explicit forecast model; assigned to data analyst (Sana Patel).
2026-01-22: Design reviewed canary UX on Console for warm-pool toggles and per-route fallback; design feedback: expose expected cost delta and SLO delta inline. DES review ticket created.
2026-01-24: Blocker noted: dependency on billing-rate API (ENG-92345). Eng estimates fix in 2 sprints—will delay automated cost gating until resolved.

2026-01-25: Plan updated: split deliverables into Pilot (Q2 limited pilot, select customers) and Platform roll (Q3 general availability). Added explicit ops runbook items for oncall and incident playbooks.
okrs: OKR-2026-Q2-1: Reduce 99th-tail cold-start latency for reserved pools by 25%
OKR-2026-Q2-2: Demonstrate a pilot fractional reservation with <=12% cost uplift and improved availability for 5 pilot customers
OKR-2026-Q2-3: Establish canary pass criteria and rollback runbook with <15% false positive rate
